args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. Bump from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4, the
minimal fixed version on the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson < 2.9.4.

## Details
- Chose **2.9.4**, the minimal fixed version on the same 2.x major line, to minimize upgrade risk. (3.1.0 also fixes the CVE but would be a major-version migration.)
- No other dependencies changed; `requests==2.32.3` untouched.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

Requested reviewer: @alex (code-owner approval required for merge to main).
